verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing docs confirm platform-enforced transaction rules that auto-approve/decline authorizations and marketing copy claims 'dynamic spending limits' and 'approval workflows,' supporting per-card/cardholder spend controls enforced server-side rather than in the client's own code. However, the evidence never specifies configurable amount caps split by daily/monthly/all-time windows, nor explicit transaction-count velocity rules, leaving the exact mechanics of the story unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of time-windowed (daily/monthly/all-time) amount caps and count-based velocity rule configuration, plus any independent/hands-on confirmation.
